summary.ko: 에스토니아 탈린 공과대학교의 실제 사무·연구시설. SmartLivingEPC가 IFC와 별도의 계측 데이터를 공개했습니다.
summary.en: Tallinn University of Technology's office and laboratory building, published by SmartLivingEPC with its IFC and a separate measurement archive.

attribution: Veliskaki, A., et al. (2025), SmartlivingEPC public building BIM model and measurements, v1, Zenodo, DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.15782433. CC BY 4.0.

areas.exteriorWallNote: 40 walls selected by IfcRelSpaceBoundary PHYSICAL/EXTERNAL element references; area from each wall's stated NetSideArea, falling back to Dimensions.Area where no NetSideArea is stated (openings already removed). Boundary surface areas are not used.
areas.openingsNote: Glazing aperture 548.52 m² = 72 IfcWindow at OverallWidth × OverallHeight (518.29 m²) + 5 exterior IfcCurtainWall at the projected outline of their plates and mullions (30.23 m²; the glass plates alone give 0 m², the bounding rectangles 45.74 m²). Exterior doors are separate — a door is aperture, not glazing: 10 IfcDoor, 58.34 m², OverallWidth × OverallHeight. Host wall by IfcRelFillsElement → IfcOpeningElement → IfcRelVoidsElement (55 openings); a curtain wall is its own wall segment (5); 27 door(s) inside a curtain wall. Sector is the host wall's, from the same orientation pass as the wall split. Envelope by a both-sides probe against the conditioned IfcSpace solids (115 of 115 have geometry): 20 curtain wall(s) with a room on both sides excluded as interior screens (50.5 m²); 109 openings hosted in walls outside the exterior set; 0 window(s) (0 m²) and 3 door(s) (14.15 m²) sit in the plane of walls outside the exterior-wall set and are not counted — the wall names are on each row; 6 unresolved (3.43 m² where a size is stated). IsExternal is reported per row and never used as a filter — it means "not an interior partition" to an authoring tool, never "bounds conditioned space against outdoor air". It marks 16 door(s) here; 10 confirm against an exterior wall, 6 do not: #310460 SU-A04:2346868 4.4 m², #310477 SU-A04:3189385 4.06 m², #310527 SU-A04:2347869 4.06 m², #352362 Uks:2-paneeli:2893700 4.52 m², #502255 Uks_1:1-paneel:4487293 4.93 m², #325145 Uks-Vent. rest:Rest_3:2473430 3.43 m². Rows in openings.json.
areas.volumeNote: Gross from 115 spaces (floor area × storey height; voids, and rooms taller than their storey with no void above, as their own solids); net from 115 spaces (115 from stated volume quantity). A closed tessellation's signed volume is exact.
areas.roofNote: Plan shadow per element (union of its projected triangles, ifc-plan-shadow.mjs): 20 elements — 11 IfcRoof, 9 IfcCovering.PredefinedType=ROOFING. roofProjectedSqm sums 14 roof type(s), each as the union of its elements; the elements themselves sum to 1539.02 m² (elements of one type overlapping in plan) and all types together cover 1361.56 m² (one type above another). surfaceSqm is each element's true one-sheet surface (Σ area of its upward faces; ÷ 2 where a surface model has no downward face and both sheets are wound upward; ÷ the coverage where its parts cover its shadow more than once, as stacked layer solids do — surfaceBasis says which), summing to 1581.14 m²; a flat deck's surface equals its shadow, a pitched roof's exceeds it. 7 element(s) present their top face more than once (upward-face sum above shadow) — the reason the shadow is used and Σ area×n_y is not. Roof element geometry is measured from the IFC. Source photovoltaic equipment is inventoried separately and must be excluded from new PV installation footprints.
areas.groundNote: IfcSlab (not ROOF or LANDING) on storeys at or below +Kelder (-3.5 m): 52 candidate(s). A slab counts as ground envelope when a conditioned space stands on it — its shadow overlaps a conditioned ground-storey space footprint (44 of 44 such spaces have one: 44 solid) or an IfcRelSpaceBoundary names it as bounding one. IsExternal is not consulted. 45 counted, 7 excluded: "Floor:trepp telg x aluspõrand:706309" 21.13 m², "Floor:trepp telg x aluspõrand:706541" 1.25 m², "Floor:trepp telg x aluspõrand:706698" 1.58 m², "Floor:trepp telg x aluspõrand:706763" 0.92 m², "Floor:trepp telg x aluspõrand:706812" 1.25 m², "Floor:trepp telg x aluspõrand:706851" 1.26 m², "Floor:trepp telg x aluspõrand:706861" 0.28 m². groundSlabSqm is the union of the counted shadows (they sum to 1173.45 m²; stacked build-up layers count once); groundPerimeterM is the outline's outer rings (7 polygons); 4 hole ring(s) totalling 44.99 m are reported and not added.

orientation.note: Azimuths are clockwise from north, where north is the model's -Z after web-ifc's Z-up to Y-up conversion. Outward face inferred by comparing each face's centroid with the building centre, which is correct for a convex plan and can be wrong at a re-entrant corner.

site.locationNote: The source publication identifies TalTech Ehituse Mäemaja, Tallinn, Estonia. IFC coordinates are retained as stated by the source; energy climate selection is a separate explicit input.

serviceLayers.note: Actual IFC4 equipment geometry from the combined source file, including its existing photovoltaic arrays. Colours distinguish visual categories; equipment capacity and modeled energy assumptions are documented separately. This is not an inferred whole-building MEP network.

flow.reason: Source port directions do not establish supply/return system roles in this combined model; animation is not published.

architecturalDetails.triangleCountBasis: triangleCount stores each instanced shape once; placedTriangleCount includes every placement
architecturalDetails.appearance: web-ifc tessellator RGBA, including possible default styles; no inferred finish textures. Metalness 0 and roughness 0.85 are renderer assumptions, not measured material properties.
architecturalDetails.note: Selected source IFC entity classes omitted from the core fabric layer. Original tessellated geometry and placements; repeated shapes use GPU instancing. Not a claim of complete architectural or fabrication detail. Existing services remain separate.

summary.ko: 통합 IFC의 냉난방·배관·말단기기와 기존 태양광 형상을 표시합니다. 별도 계측 파일을 연간 에너지 계산과 보정한 결과는 아닙니다.
summary.en: Shows source heating/cooling equipment, pipes, terminals and existing PV from the combined IFC. The separate metering archive has not been used to calibrate the modeled annual energy output.

limitations.ko: 해시로 고정된 IFC 파일에서 해당 스키마의 설비 분류 상속을 확인한 요소 목록이며, 실제 설치 설비의 완전성 조사가 아닙니다.
limitations.en: Inventory of distribution occurrence classes using each pinned IFC file's schema inheritance, not a completeness survey of installed services.

limitations.ko: 분야별·수정본 모델 간 요소가 중복될 수 있으며 파일 간 설비 중복 제거는 하지 않았습니다.
limitations.en: Counts include overlapping discipline and revision models; there is no cross-file equipment deduplication.

limitations.ko: 일반 IfcBuildingElementProxy·IfcFurnishingElement는 원본 근거 없이 MEP로 분류하지 않습니다.
limitations.en: Generic IfcBuildingElementProxy and IfcFurnishingElement occurrences are not classified as MEP without source evidence.

model.note: Building fabric only: walls, slabs, roofs and openings. Furniture, fixtures, railings and the structural frame are not in this file.
model.serviceNote: Service layers carry every component at the model's own geometry; a repeated shape is stored once and placed by instancing.

invalidDiagnostics.note: Space-boundary strip sums. INVALID as envelope areas: room-height not storey-height, gross of openings, double-counted where boundaries overlap, and blind to any wall without a resolvable boundary surface. Diagnostic only; never an emitted area.

sourcePhysics.note: Typed and alternate source thermal/equipment properties with property-set and type references; not measured operating performance.
